data.one_liner: Shows a remotely controlled force update prompt for Android and iOS apps.
data.what_it_does: Fetches a required minimum version from a remote source, compares it with the current app version, and displays a customizable update alert when a newer version is required. It triggers on app start and when returning to the foreground.
use_when: You need to force users to update their app when breaking API changes occur
You want to manage the minimum required app version remotely via Firebase Remote Config or a custom backend
avoid_when: You are building for web or desktop platforms
You prefer an automatic solution that checks app store listings directly without a backend endpoint
strengths: UI-agnostic layout lets you fully control the look and localization of the update prompt
Uses semantic versioning via pub_semver for reliable version comparison
Small and straightforward implementation with minimal classes
weaknesses: Does not support web or desktop platforms
Requires a remote endpoint or remote config setup to supply the required version
data.setup_notes: Add ForceUpdateWidget to the MaterialApp builder and configure the iOS App Store ID if targeting iOS.
